purpose: Determine whether caching the exact incumbent F16 representation of ffn_gate or ffn_up individually beats the qualified ffn_down c64 aggregate profile.
hardware: Two local Intel Arc Pro B70 cards; no remote host.
fixed_configuration: Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M, llama.cpp SYCL TP2 tensor 1,1, MTP0, normal MMQ Q4_K reorder, WDC and WDC pre-reorder off, 64 pinned slots, total context 32768, batch 2048, ubatch 256, FUSE_EXT=31, temperature 0, prompt cache off, 128 generated token IDs per request, inference admission target 64 with 1000 ms fail-safe ceiling.
advance_rule: Each arm must independently pass 64/64 complete token identity, zero cached tokens, zero cross-base collisions, cache liveness, clean shutdown, and kernel-health gates. Repeat only a candidate that exceeds 168.344562 tok/s, the higher of the two already-qualified ffn_down runs. A one-run screen cannot replace the public result.
publication_policy: Failed, slower, OOM, or single-run speeds remain scoped screening evidence. No interpolation, extrapolation, best-run promotion, prompt/output caching, or transfer to single-user decode.
